results.description:
Ro Bergeron's grandparents raised her to be, well, helpless. She can't boil an egg or keep a plant alive. Why not open a bed and breakfast for humans and their canine friends?

But when her meddlesome great aunts find a local murder too irresistible, Ro's life is turned upside down! 

As Min and Win Rascoe indulge their sleuthing skills, a reluctant Ro and her enthusiastic house guests are drawn into the mystery.

Will the Rascoe sisters and their unconventional team solve the murder before Ro's high school crush Detective Jason Charbonnet? Can Ro master the skills of cooking and hosting?

This book is the first of the Three Dog Mystery Series.
